title: OSD fingerprint 0.5
description: What a detection observed of one device plugged in, and the device the person confirmed it is. Matched against device descriptors (their identity block and controls) to recognise a model that does not identify itself; confirmed fingerprints teach the next detection; one of a device no descriptor describes yet, with the controls the person named, starts its descriptor. It holds nothing about the person or the machine: port names are kept as their words, without numbers.

^_.description: A note for people; never read by a program.

via.description: A web browser (no USB identity) or a program on the machine.

^_.description: A note for people; never read by a program.

ports.description: The device's MIDI port names, lower case, words only.

controls.description: The controls that arrived while the person turned knobs, in order, without their values.

device.description: What the person confirmed it is: a descriptor, or, for a device no descriptor describes yet, its maker and model as they name it; absent when they did not say.

names.description: Controls the person named while teaching it: what a control does, in their words or a common address name (filter cutoff).
